title: Cursor Releases Agent SDK for Building AI Agents
summary:
The toolset allows developers to define AI agents using TypeScript for tools and Markdown for prompts. These agents can be run on a user's own infrastructure or deployed through Cursor's hosted services.

The release includes built-in evaluations designed to let developers measure changes to agent behavior and refine their performance over time.
